description: Source code for the fsmonitor--daemon component of Git, implementing filesystem monitoring daemon with IPC, thread management, and token-based change tracking.

classes.name: fsmonitor_token_data
classes.description: Represents a token with an ID, associated batch list, and reference count.

classes.name: fsmonitor_batch
classes.description: Represents a batch of interned file paths with sequence number and pinned time.

classes.name: fsmonitor_daemon_state
classes.description: Holds the state of the filesystem monitor daemon, including thread handles, IPC, configuration, and token data.

methods.name: fsmonitor_new_token_data
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new token data structure with a batch.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__new
methods.description: Allocates and returns a new empty batch.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__free_list
methods.description: Frees a linked list of batches.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__add_path
methods.description: Adds a path to a batch, interning the string.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__combine
methods.description: Merges paths from one batch into another.

methods.name: fsmonitor_free_token_data
methods.description: Frees a token data structure and its associated batches.

methods.name: fsmonitor_force_resync
methods.description: Forces a resynchronization by creating a new token and aborting cookies.

methods.name: with_lock__format_response_token
methods.description: Formats a response token string with current token ID and sequence number.

methods.name: fsmonitor_parse_client_token
methods.description: Parses a client-provided token string into token ID and sequence number.

methods.name: do_handle_client
methods.description: Handles client commands over IPC, including quit, flush, and token-based requests.

methods.name: handle_client
methods.description: IPC callback that delegates to do_handle_client.

methods.name: fsmonitor_run_daemon
methods.description: Initializes and runs the filesystem monitor daemon, starting threads and setting up watches.

methods.name: fsmonitor_run_daemon_1
methods.description: Starts IPC, listener, and health threads, and manages shutdown.

methods.name: try_to_start_background_daemon
methods.description: Attempts to spawn a background daemon process.

methods.name: cmd_fsmonitor__daemon
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git fsmonitor--daemon' subcommands: start, run, stop, status.
